question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
gold_answer: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.
candidate_answer: The chosen consultant is expected to be retained for **five years**, with a maximum of **seven years** including any renewals or extensions. [Source: Shrewsbury RFP, p. 1]
